name: Panels from an extension
what: An extension can create a panel in the app through a tool, as it sends an alert. The panel is data that the app draws with its own components, so no code of the extension runs in the app. A click in the panel wakes the extension's computer.

suggest.why: Without a place of its own, an extension's findings end up in alerts, and drawing them from data keeps someone else's code out of the app.
